title: Show HN: I replaced a $120k bowling center system with $1,600 in ESP32s
summary: A Site Reliability Engineer used ESP32 microcontrollers to replace a $120,000 commercial bowling center management system for just $1,600, saving his family's rural bowling alley from abandonment by modernizing 70-year-old equipment with IoT solutions.
problem_solved: Replaced expensive proprietary bowling alley management systems with affordable open-source hardware solutions.
why_valuable: Demonstrates how modern IoT hardware can democratize expensive automation systems, saving $118,000 while bringing recreation to an underserved rural community.
